frozen_theorems: Under binary scalar q/g/y and typed upstream DROP, exactly four weak-semantic rows exist.
Under strong q-necessity and g-gate semantics, N0 and N1 are conditionally exhaustive.
X0/X1 are ontology-obstruction signatures unless a revised semantic model is prospectively justified.
Same measured (q,g) with different y falsifies deterministic scalar y=f(q,g).
Rank 3 requires a third admissible direction and cannot be promoted from rank alone.
For structured gate vector G with dimension >=2, partial upstream coupling yields genuine intermediate support families beyond scalar N0/N1.

same measured q,g with different y under admissible non-y state/intervention; exclude measurement mismatch

selection_rule: Prefer the strongest exact fresh mechanism that can distinguish ontology extension from mere relabeling. Do not rescue a candidate by redefining q,g,y after observing its signature.
stop_conditions: If no candidate permits direct coordinate measurement, hold rather than infer from prose architecture.
If the only apparent third family disappears after preserving q as an actually necessary quotient, classify semantic mis-specification rather than novelty.
If structured G collapses to scalar g without information loss under all admissible interventions, do not claim a new family.
Do not open LAW-R2 from architecture-taxonomy failure alone.
